mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM mission_daily_usage WHERE student_id=#{student} AND usage_date=#{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission_daily_usage(attempt_id,student_id,mission_id,usage_date,created_at) VALUES(#{attempt},#{student},#{mission},#{date},#{now}) ON CONFLICT (attempt_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id FROM mission_daily_usage WHERE student_id=#{student} AND mission_id=#{mission} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
